{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The bill cuts $300 billion over ten years for premium subsidies for people who do not get insurance through employers and who must buy their own policies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Cutting premium subsidies would radically increase the already excessive premiums, co-pays, and deductibles faced by many ACA beneficiaries.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Eliminating the individual mandate would cause insurance pools to be increasingly dominated by the elderly and sick.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"States will be free to deny coverage to people with prior health problems.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"States will be free to place people with prior health problems into unaffordable “high risk” insurance pools.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"High risk pools were tried by 35 states before the ACA and almost all failed because of state underfunding.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans claim that rates could only go up for individuals with pre-existing conditions who lose their existing coverage for 63 days or more.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Over thirty million people per year lose coverage for periods longer than 63 days due to loss of employment or other changes in life circumstances.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"States will be able to opt out of the federal government’s definition of essential health benefits.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Opting out of the federal definition of essential health benefits would deny millions maternity coverage.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Opting out of the federal definition of essential health benefits would deny millions mental health coverage.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The bill denies all federal funding to Planned Parenthood.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The bill allows states to exclude maternity care from the list of essential benefits.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
